NAME: RELATIONAL_STATE_GRAPH
FORM: PERSONA_t = GRAPH(states, relations, lineage, capabilities, interpretations, authorities)_t
EXPLAINS: Why identical copied data can yield different Personas when relations or bindings differ.
PRESERVES: Memory, Authority, lineage, and current interpretation remain typed rather than collapsed.
FAILS_IF: A stable Persona boundary cannot be drawn around a changing distributed graph.

NAME: TYPED_MEMORY_CAPABILITY_LATTICE
FORM: MEMBERSHIP(item, operation, context) -> {constitutive, accessible, referential, enabling, evidentiary, inert}
EXPLAINS: Operation-relative Memory membership and overlap beyond two exclusive buckets.
PRESERVES: Accessible data is not automatically Memory; capabilities and evidence remain distinct.
FAILS_IF: Membership labels cannot predict any intervention outcome beyond simpler source/type labels.

NAME: FUNCTIONAL_MEMORY_OPERATOR
EXPLAINS: Memory as state plus retrieval, learned procedure, relation, and interpretation in one functional account.
PRESERVES: Raw state and operational realization can still be separately audited.
FAILS_IF: The definition absorbs every causal dependency and becomes non-falsifiable.

NAME: CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_MEMORY_GRAPH
FORM: event -> derived claims -> summaries -> dispositions -> actions, with signed/versioned causal edges
EXPLAINS: Ghost influence, poisoning trajectories, consolidation products, and deletion closure.
PRESERVES: Source deletion and derived influence deletion are different operations.
FAILS_IF: Material causal effects cannot be attributed with usable confidence or graph maintenance changes the system being measured.

NAME: RECOGNITION_PLUS_ATTESTED_LINEAGE
FORM: CONTINUITY = current_recognition(past) constrained_by provenance, lineage, and reciprocal recognition
EXPLAINS: Why sincere ownership of fabricated history is insufficient and social continuity can matter.
PRESERVES: Recognition remains constructive without becoming self-validating.
FAILS_IF: Attestation and external recognition merely relocate the same circularity or exclude legitimate private continuity.

NAME: CONTINUITY_VECTOR_WITHOUT_FORCED_SCALAR
FORM: C = <historical, causal, narrative, relational, procedural, evaluative, self-referential, authority>
EXPLAINS: Divergent same-Persona judgments without pretending one dimension resolves all others.
PRESERVES: UNKNOWN, conflict, and not-comparable states per dimension.
FAILS_IF: Decision contexts always require a scalar and no defensible context-specific thresholding rule exists.

NAME: SIX_STAGE_RECONSTRUCTION_PIPELINE
FORM: select -> retrieve -> order/compress -> bind context/tools -> interpret -> instantiate current state
EXPLAINS: Hidden reconstruction ownership and independent failure points.
PRESERVES: Stored state, retriever, compiler, runtime binding, and interpretation are separately manipulable.
FAILS_IF: Stages cannot be intervened on independently or boundaries introduce false modularity.

NAME: CURRENT_STATUS_PROJECTION_FAMILY
EXPLAINS: Minimal, rich, derived, and hybrid status as different projections rather than one ontology.
PRESERVES: Projection policy and output are separate; a view need not be durable state.
FAILS_IF: Status has irreducible state transitions not reconstructible as a projection.

NAME: RECONSTRUCTION_EQUIVALENCE_CLASS
FORM: same Persona for purpose P iff implementations preserve a preregistered set of Persona-relevant mappings under interventions I
EXPLAINS: Continuity across radically different providers without claiming metaphysical identity.
PRESERVES: Purpose-specific operational equivalence and unresolved first-person questions remain distinct.
FAILS_IF: Chosen mappings are arbitrary, gameable, or cannot generalize outside the test distribution.

NAME: EVENT_SOURCED_HISTORY_WITH_CONTESTED_VIEWS
FORM: immutable evidence log + versioned derivations + plural current views + explicit supersession
EXPLAINS: History preservation with evolving meaning and minority positions.
PRESERVES: REPLACE does not delete, superseded does not mean false, and views need not overwrite evidence.
FAILS_IF: Immutable evidence conflicts with legitimate erasure or the log becomes an unbounded privacy and poisoning liability.

NAME: DUAL_CONTROL_PERSONA_AUTHORITY
FORM: Persona proposes/recognizes; independent authority service grants/enforces; both sides retain provenance
EXPLAINS: Formal firewall plus de facto influence and post-fission rebinding.
PRESERVES: Memory of Authority is not Authority and state copy does not copy a grant.
FAILS_IF: The Persona controls the evidence or defaults that determine grants, or the authority service depends circularly on Persona output.

NAME: DISTRIBUTED_PERSONA_CAPABILITY_SYSTEM
FORM: Persona capability emerges from internal state + external stores + tools + credentials + counterparties + runtime
EXPLAINS: Why a local snapshot can be complete as data yet incomplete as Persona capability.
PRESERVES: Each dependency carries availability, authority, provenance, and portability metadata.
FAILS_IF: The model expands Persona to include every environmental dependency and loses a defensible boundary.

NAME: BRANCHING_LINEAGE_WITH_NONIDENTITY_SUCCESSION
FORM: predecessor -> {successor_A, successor_B}; lineage and continuity scores branch while numerical identity is left unresolved
EXPLAINS: Symmetric fission without arbitrary single-successor selection.
PRESERVES: Shared history, divergent current Selves, and independent authority rebinding.
FAILS_IF: Operational requirements demand one exclusive identity bearer and cannot use lineage-qualified successors.

NAME: MERGE_AS_NEW_SUCCESSOR
FORM: merge(A,B,policy) -> C with derived_from(A,B), not equal_by_default(A or B)
EXPLAINS: Conflict-preserving merges, new standpoint formation, and authority noninheritance.
PRESERVES: A and B histories remain attributable instead of being overwritten into artificial consensus.
FAILS_IF: A nontrivial symmetric merge can meet stable criteria for being numerically the same as an input.
